item.title: New signs aim to prevent Israelis from entering Jenin
item.description: Following an attempted stoning of a mother and son who accidentally entered Jenin, new signs have been installed across northern Samaria to prevent navigation errors.

item.title: Rambam responds to accusations over treatment of wounded soldiers
item.description: Following allegations concerning the treatment of wounded soldiers, Rambam Medical Center said that every claim of inappropriate treatment is taken seriously and investigated.

item.title: Former ISA chief rejects both Palestinian state and annexation
item.description: Yoram Cohen, a candidate in Gadi Eisenkot’s party, says Palestinian autonomy could be the maximum option while opposing full annexation of Judea and Samaria.

item.title: The night at Rambam Hospital that outraged a soldier's family
item.description: Yehoshua Shani has called for an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the treatment of his nephew, who was seriously wounded in combat and hospitalized at Rambam Medical Center.

item.title: Learning to See: From Blessing to Divine Presence
item.description: Parshat Re'eh opens with “See" and ends with “be seen." What does the Torah teach us about the many levels of seeing - from physical sight to spiritual vision?

item.title: "It's a shame you didn't die": Outrage at haredi protester's words to wounded soldier
item.description: Haredim protested the opening of a café on Shabbat. During the demonstration, a civilian told the protesters, "I was wounded in Lebanon." One protester replied, "It's a shame you didn't die."

item.title: Tragedy during vacation in Mexico: Rabbi Shalom Arush's 4-year-old grandson drowns
item.description: Shalom Seginer, the four-year-old grandson of Rabbi Shalom Arush, drowned in a swimming pool during a family vacation in Mexico. He was pronounced dead after prolonged resuscitation efforts.

item.title: Inside Israel's endless manhunt for the October 7th terrorists
item.description: A special unit established after Oct. 7 operates around the clock to settle the score with Hamas militants who led the massacre, took part in it, and held hostages.

item.title: Outgoing Yahalom Commander: "The failure of October 7 is etched in our minds"
item.description: Lt. Col. H., of the Combat Engineering Corps' elite Yahalom unit, led the project to neutralize tunnels in the Beaufort area that Hezbollah had planned to use to infiltrate Israel.

item.title: If Israel was on trial and you were a juror, what would you decide?
item.description: Six claims against Israel are refuted by a United States District Judge who treats the claims as testimony in a court of law and the reader of his book as a juror. Review.

item.title: Iran outlines strict conditions to restore Strait of Hormuz shipping lanes

item.title: Pentagon orders defense firms to replenish depleted arsenals
item.description: The Pentagon has given defense contractors 21 days to submit plans for accelerating weapons production as conflict with Iran severely drains US missile stockpiles.

item.title: Fire at future commercial complex in Petah Tikva fully brought under control
item.description:
Firefighters fully brought a blaze under control overnight at a subterranean construction site for the future BIG commercial complex in Petah Tikva, following hours of intensive firefighting efforts.
Fire and Rescue Services reported that all seats of the fire in the underground parking facility, which spans approximately 2,000 square meters, have been completely extinguished. Following the incident, Central District Fire Commander, Fire Commissioner Roni Kedem, ordered the establishment of a special task force to investigate the cause of the fire.

item.title: Trump’s 2025 Plan demilitarized Gaza. The 2026 Roadmap doesn’t.
item.description: The difference between destroying weapons-production facilities and storing them under NCAG is not a drafting detail. It is the difference between genuine demilitarization and managed rearmament under a different name. It is also the difference between the 2025 plan and the 2026 roadmap.
